name: Weitzman Gardeners
description: We believe in the transformative potential of gardens both within the design of public spaces and individual’s lives. The club strives to provide experiential learning for Weitzman students with the earth outside the classroom, and create a forum to connect and explore our interest in the many facets of gardening. By identifying and working with campus and other local partners, we aim to use gardening as a way to get our hands in the dirt and improve the greater community.

description: The Penn Wellness Student Coalition (PWSC) is the student-led wellness umbrella group on campus. description: Wharton Crew (graduate rowing and crew team) is a student-run rowing team at the University of Pennsylvania dedicated to providing access to rowing opportunities for seasoned, novice, and brand-new rowers! description: Since 2004, the Wharton Energy Conference has been bringing students and professionals from Philadelphia and across the country together to discuss trends and changes in the energy industry. Topics covered include renewable energy, energy finance, and business innovations that are changing the energy landscape. We convene typically around 300 attendees annually.

description: The Wharton International Business and Economics Club (WIBEC) at Penn is a premier undergraduate finance club focusing on the intersection of economics, global affairs, and international relations. Through conversation with industry professionals, analysis of current events, and club workshops, this club aims to provide members with a stronger understanding of how to navigate the world of global business. Individual goals range widely, including preparation for a future career, establishing industry connections, or simply learning where to put capital.

description: The Wharton Investment and Trading Group (WITG) is the premier undergraduate student group at Penn for professional preparation in finance-related careers. description: The Wharton Israel Club connects the Wharton community with Israel's business and innovation ecosystem. We bring students together with Israeli founders, investors, and business leaders through our flagship Wharton Israel Innovation Conference in New York, the annual Israel Trek, speaker events, and social and cultural gatherings. Whether you're Israeli or have never been to Israel, everyone is welcome.

Through a variety of programmed and co-hosted events, we celebrate the best of the MBA program and provide a space to unwind after the week, mingle across classes, and form deeper connections with students, professors and alumni.

This student-run club is committed to inclusivity and welcomes participants of all experience levels.

name: Wharton Undergraduate Real Estate Club
description: The Wharton Undergraduate Real Estate Club is dedicated to everything real estate. We educate Penn community about the real estate industry and expose undergraduate students to various opportunities in the field. WUREC seeks to provide an intellectual environment that not only allows students to learn, but also network, recruit, travel, and build foundations for success and a career in real estate.

name: Wharton Undergraduate Sports Business Club

description: The Wharton Undergraduate Statistics Society (USS) is your resource for all things statistics at Penn. Without a Net is an undergraduate student group at the University of Pennsylvania and was the first co-ed comedy group created on Penn's campus . We currently perform both long and short-form improv at various venues throughout the year. Over the past 35 years, we have made appearances at numerous venues including Penn events, collegiate improv tournaments, World Cafe Live, the Philly Improv Theater in Center City, and Irvine Auditorium.

name: Women in Computer Science (WiCS)
description: Women in Computer Science (WiCS) is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania that aims to foster a community supporting the advancement of women in tech. Our purpose is to support and promote students who identify as women in CS by encouraging discussion and raising awareness of issues affecting women in computer science. WiCS is open to all students, regardless of gender, gender identity, or sexual orientation, who support the mission of WiCS.

description: Women in Consulting (WinC) empowers students at the University of Pennsylvania who are passionate about consulting. Our mission is to build a strong network of knowledge, mentorship, and opportunity by fostering connections, supporting members through every stage of the recruitment process, and creating spaces for learning, collaboration, and growth. description: Women in Life Sciences (WILS) at Penn is committed to its following core values: (1) to create a community for members of the undergraduate community whose majors strongly encompass the life sciences, but who do not lie on the pre-medical track, with a focus on the experiences of women-identifying individuals, (2) offer career insight and advice from alumni and professionals in a variety of fields related to biotech, healthcare, academia, and more, (3) and to foster meaningful social and professional relationships with club members across all four years. Any student is welcome to join!

name: Women in Physics
description: Women in Physics (WiP) at the University of Pennsylvania aims to support undergraduate students of marginalized genders who are underrepresented in physics. We strive to create an inclusive community by hosting casual study breaks and peer mentorship opportunities, alongside professional development opportunities and speaker events. WiP invites students of all gender identities who support the advancement of women in physics to join.

name: Women's Biomedical Society at Penn
description: The mission of Women's Biomedical Society at Penn, a student group at the University of Pennsylvania, is to provide undergraduates with information and opportunities pertaining to graduate schools and careers in the biomedical field. WBSP strives to bring together a diverse group of women to (a) promote high academic achievement in science (b) connect to mentors/female STEM professionals, (c) serve the greater West Philly community, and (d) engage in science-related educational activities. We are open to all students who share an interest in the biomedical sciences.

name: Women's Club Basketball at Penn
description: Women's Club Basketball at Penn is a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania. The club provides those passionate about basketball with the opportunity to continue playing in college within a competitive and fun environment. Most members played competitive basketball in high school. We travel to a variety of tournaments throughout the year, and we play other collegiate club teams. We also host fundraisers, social events and hope to incorporate some volunteering this coming year!

name: Women's Club Ice Hockey
description: Women's Club Ice Hockey. We are a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania that is compromised of undergraduates and graduate students and beginners. We practice and play home games at the Class of 1923 Arena. Our season runs from September to February with around 20 games a season and two practices per week.

name: Women's Club Lacrosse
description: Penn Women's Club Lacrosse is a student group and club sport at the University of Pennsylvania governed completely by its members and our executive board works together to coach and maintain the team. We practice twice per week, and we compete intercollegiately in both the fall and the spring, playing teams in the greater Philadelphia area, New Jersey, New York, Maryland, and Delaware! In addition to being competitive, we are a social group and we like to think of ourselves as a family both on and off the field. Both undergrads and grad students are welcome to join!

name: Women's Club Rugby
description: Women's Rugby at Penn is a student-run club sport team governed completely by its members. As a part of National Collegiate Rugby, we compete intercollegiately in both the fall and the spring. In addition to being competitive, we are quite a social group, and we tend to think of ourselves as not just as a team, but also a family. All Penn students (undergraduate and graduate) are welcome to join.

name: Women’s Club Soccer at Penn

Though our primary season takes place in the fall, we practice throughout the year and have outdoor friendly matches in the spring as well. The club atmosphere is not as rigorous as varsity college sports, but it is significantly more competitive than intramural teams. Our season runs from September to May and includes two 2-hour practices per week (three during tournament weeks), 3–4 single-day tournaments each semester, and the annual 3-day National Tournament in April.
